an4.104:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave cattāro’me udakarahadūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.104:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti gambhīrobhāso?
an4.104:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.104:2.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.104:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti gambhīrobhāso.
an4.104:2.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado uttāno gambhīrobhāso,
an4.104:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti uttānobhāso?
an4.104:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.104:3.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.104:3.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti uttānobhāso.
an4.104:3.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado gambhīro uttānobhāso,
an4.104:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti uttānobhāso?
an4.104:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.104:4.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.104:4.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti uttānobhāso.
an4.104:4.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado uttāno uttānobhāso,
an4.104:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti gambhīrobhāso?
an4.104:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.104:5.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.104:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti gambhīrobhāso.
an4.104:5.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado gambhīro gambhīrobhāso,
an4.104:5.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro udakarahadūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
